text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Japan Cup, Cheval Grand 
requested to run in the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She decided that facing Vivlos on the 
racetrack would help her grow even 
stronger for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three-way sister showdown came 
to pass at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
Sparks flew between the fiercely 
competitive sisters, sending the 
excitement soaring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Cheval Grand was no longer 
intimidated by being alongside the two 
glamorous stars bathing in cheers. With 
the fans' voices at her back, she would 
show her true strength.
